description:
Most AI voiceovers sound robotic. But the voice your hearing in this video? It's 100% AI, yet it's kinda realistic.

In this video, I'm breaking how how I make realistic AI voiceovers that actually sound like human. I'll show you the software I use, the settings to get that human tone, the editing workflow, and a secret feature.

If you want to learn how to make realistic AI voiceovers, how to use ElevenLabs like a pro, or how to dub your videos to reach millions of new viewers, I'm sure you're gonna get something from this one. Hope you enjoy 🙂
